text:
Devon: hey team — first day here! quick access Q: I don't see the Feature Flags page in Redwood Console (staging). I need to flip a canary flag for an integration smoke test. who can grant toggle perms?
Sam: welcome! :tada: pinging infra and @Jess — they handle most flag perms. do you have your github/okta id handy?
Devon: thanks! github: devon-w. staging only, not prod.
Jess: @Kelsey / infra-bot can you check Devon's roles and what it would take to give a short-lived feature-flag write?
infra-bot: IAM lookup: devon-w -> roles: console-reader, billing-view. Missing permissions: featureflag:write (console.admin). Policy: temporary grants require approval + ticket. See https://docs.redwood.ai/ops/iam#temporary-grants
Kelsey: Devon — which flag? name + intended window? we prefer TTL <= 4h for ad-hoc dev flips.
Devon: flag is integration_canary_v2, flip to true for ~30 minutes while I run end-to-end tests. I'll rollback after.
Sam: pls open a quick platform ticket and tag me + Jess — include flag name, reason, and TTL. I can approve.
Devon: created PLAT-1423 https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PLAT-1423 — brief: "temp write for integration_canary_v2 on staging (30m)"
Jess: approved in the ticket. Kelsey, can infra perform the grant?
Kelsey: doing a temporary grant now. command: `grant-role --user=devon-w --role=featureflag:write --env=staging --ttl=30m --note="onboarding test"`
infra-bot: Role grant started. audit tracking id=aud-0a1b2c. Grant will auto-revoke at +30m.
infra-bot: Role grant complete. devon-w now has featureflag:write on staging. audit id=aud-0a1b2c. :white_check_mark:
Devon: awesome — flipping the flag now. curl example: `curl -X POST "https://console.staging.redwood.ai/api/flags/toggle" -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"flag":"integration_canary_v2","state":true}'`
Sam: heads-up: prefer using the Console UI toggle or the scheduled toggle feature for short tests. it adds audit metadata automatically. docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/feature-flags#scheduled-toggles
Devon: used the UI. test ran green. rolling back now. thanks everyone! :heart:
Jess: added a note to the new-hire checklist: request FF perms early during onboarding. saves time.
Kelsey: logged the action in the ops runbook and linked PLAT-1423 for traceability.
Devon: big help — appreciate the fast turnaround.
